headline: Jaeha Kim presents a UVM state-coverage testbench for DFE adaptation convergence
fact: Jaeha Kim of Seoul National University presents a DVCon Europe paper on checking a four-tap, six-bit sign-sign LMS DFE adaptation loop with SystemVerilog/XMODEL and UVM. Shared state coverage and a global UVM event select unvisited starting states. The examples find false locked states with high channel loss or unconstrained coefficients. With a -20-dB channel at 8 GHz and explicit coefficient-magnitude and ordering constraints, the paper reports covering 2,347 states in 1,721 trials over 5 hours 12 minutes. The convergence result applies to this constrained discrete model, not arbitrary channels or all continuous analog states. Scientific Analog and IDEC supplied EDA-tool support; the author affiliation is SNU.

sources.title: A UVM Testbench for Checking the Global Convergence of Analog/Mixed-Signal Systems: An Adaptive Decision-Feedback Equalizer Example — author preprint
sources.summary: The cover dates preprint 15247 to October 18, 2024. Sections IV–V define visited-state handling, failure examples and the constrained 2,347-state success case; acknowledgments identify tool support.
